$comment: Index of repovine MCP eval cards. Each card is an agent-driven, repo-agnostic regression/audit prompt scored against its frontmatter `checks`. Not run by `npm test`. See README.md. v2 adds machine-readable `axes` and `profiles`: every card carries `axis` (what it tests) and `profiles` (which target graph states it is meaningful in), so a runner can select e.g. the cold-graph build-signal set deterministically instead of from prose.

axes.build-signal: Structural extraction / indexing / projection / navigation. The verdict rests on extracted structure (the preamble evidence gate forbids a PASS from annotations alone). Annotation text is part of the search index, so search hits and ranking still differ between 0% and 99% coverage.
axes.annotation-quality: Annotation memory itself — mechanics (coverage/queue/merge/validate) and content (secrets, sideEffects vocabulary, provenance/freshness, grounding).
axes.meta: Audit methodology and MCP plumbing rather than one extraction surface — stack inventory / N-A discipline and context-session threading + quality scoring.

cold-graph.target_state: freshly built graph before annotation onboarding (every coverage bucket reports annotated 0)
cold-graph.purpose: Truest build-signal regression — modules indexed/parsed, entrypoints/edges/config extracted — with no annotations able to mask a broken extractor. Turns the preamble's 'do not lean on annotations' instruction into an enforced invariant (there are none to lean on).
cold-graph.note: annotation-quality is intentionally excluded (whole-card N/A with no annotations). annotation-health and the annotation-driven checks in architecture-detectors stay in: they verify the annotation surfaces behave correctly against an empty store (figures/queue empty, annotation checks N/A) without crashing.

annotated.target_state: graph after annotation onboarding (a coverage bucket reports annotated above 0)
annotated.purpose: Annotation coverage/queue/merge and content quality, plus the annotation-driven analyze_architecture paths (annotationReasoning enrichment + annotation-content gating of the finding set). Build-signal cards pass on the same extracted structure; annotation text adds search hits and shifts ranking.
